objects.name: Analytic 1734
objects.description: For Android, detect Indicator Removal on Host by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Application Permission via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes file deletion, database truncation, log clearing, or app-data-clear operations within $CleanupWindow$ of prior data access or network exfiltration event — post-exfil cleanup chain]; System Settings via Android Enterprise DPC [DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Privacy cleaner apps approved by IT, MDM agent for managed wipe. Derive from MDM catalog. Tightening: MDM agent only — all other post-exfil cleanup is anomalous.
Default 300s after exfiltration event (network upload) within which subsequent cleanup is causally linked. Tightening: 60s — immediate post-exfil cleanup.
